headline: Season Kicks Off
body: 6 of 9 agencies checked in at the 9/4 PK session with their books. CW Seed, Heiting Seed, and Marker Ag -- catch up on the next one. Season is long, plenty of points to grab.

headline: New Category Added: Early Season Order Confirmation
body: Added a new 25 pt category tracking Early Season Order Confirmation (deadline was 9/11/2026). 8 of 9 agencies completed it -- Meyer Seeds is the only miss. Season total is now 610 pts across 22 categories. Full scoring guide is in the Rules & Definitions tab; updated PDF sent with today's Friday update.

headline: First Harvest Data In + Scoreboard Tip
body: Harvest Data is rolling in. JK Dean Ag and Meyer Seeds both hit the 1,500+ acre bonus for 40 pts each. Heiting Seed, MK Seeds, and Soule Seed Company all logged 25 pts. SCOREBOARD TIP: The % column defaults to "Available So Far" -- it only counts categories whose deadline has passed. Toggle to "Total (610 pts)" at the top of the Standings tab to see rankings against the full season (including open categories like Harvest Data). Both views are honest, they just answer different questions: who's winning the categories we've closed vs. who's banking the most season points so far.
